dogecoin.text:
Dogecoin nor Shiba Inu mooned because they were animals.

They mooned because they had cool cyberpunk vibes.

Few understand, many will.

Retail’s understanding of memecoins is still extremely primitive. All they know is dogs and scams. They are yet to embrace its true value proposition. More fair than the dollar, and more fun than Bitcoin. Most of CT doesn’t understand it either. The approval of the Dogecoin ETF

My thesis is simple.

Retail is ONLY MENTALLY ABLE to ape another memecoin en masse if it is an ENTIRELY fresh concept. 

IE, completely unrelated to Dogecoin, not punching up at Dogecoin whatsoever. 

One that makes them feel intellectual, similar to the effect SHIB had.  

But

It’s not that memecoins are prone to 90% dips, they are literally a right of passage. 

Most narratives are so fragile, they permanently die from an attention shift. 

You need to prove your narrative’s different by recovering from multiple 90% dips. 

Bitcoin, Dogecoin, Shiba
